title: Production Charges Carried by a Delivered Event
content:
The room set-up the guarantee entry is built to settles the production charges standing on a Private Event & Banquet Services final bill.

1. Where the room stood set for seated rounds or for a reception, the audio-visual package and the dance floor charge printed against the package both stand on the bill.
2. Where the room stood set for theater, for classroom or for boardroom, the audio-visual package printed against the package stands on the bill and no dance floor charge is added.
3. Where no confirmed guarantee entry stands to name a room set-up, neither of those two charges stands on the bill.

| The room stood set for | On the bill |
| --- | --- |
| Seated rounds | Audio-visual package and dance floor charge |
| Reception | Audio-visual package and dance floor charge |
| Theater | Audio-visual package alone |
| Classroom | Audio-visual package alone |
| Boardroom | Audio-visual package alone |
| No confirmed guarantee entry naming a set-up | Neither |

## The figures each package prints

| Package | Audio-visual package, USD | Dance floor charge, USD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 125 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 0 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 850 | 650 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2400 | 1200 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 4800 | 1500 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

An event on the Gala Reception Package whose guarantee entry was built to a reception carries 2400 and 1200 on the bill, that is 3600. Built to theater, it carries 2400. With no confirmed guarantee entry naming a set-up, it carries neither, whatever the room was in fact dressed as on the day.
